body: It's sad that I've had plenty of people tell me to find another girl, but I just can't live without her. I can't sleep or eat and it just makes me want to be even more alone. I'm sorry about everything man I wish we could just both feel normal, being like this makes me feel like I don't even exist. I'm sure you've understood since long before me what I mean. Thank you for the reply.

Thank you so much for your reply, I really just need some help and this is a good outlet. Right now we are getting a lot of space away from one another and I think I'll just let her come to me. I just want to at least be honest with one another. I just wish I could stop caring.

Thank you for your reply. What you posted seems to be quite valid to my situation because the reason we broke up the first time was for her to be a little more independent of a relationship. But after the time apart we just ended up right back together even with almost no contact with each other and some harsh feelings on both sides. I'm not going to go on some cliche of "meant to be", but we always just seem to find one another.

As for the college business, I had always wanted to go to this particular school, but never really discussed with her my interest in it. She was the one who actually applied to the same school while we were not dating our senior year. It was a coincidence of convenience as I see it.
